metadata.method: Experimental archive sample covering all 66 eligible audited bundles. Up to 100 hash-selected singles games per bundle in each Venue and Tournament cohort; Pro includes all evidence-mapped player sides in those bundles' conservative tournament games. Per-bundle sampling caps and archive coverage can bias estimates; counts pool opportunities, not players. Venue may include friendlies; Tournament uses the existing conservative archive curation. Cohorts overlap and are not skill ranks. All dates; exact character, opponent and stage filters.
